Data:Setup.fet.json.label: Memory: Fet?
Data:Setup.fet.json.desc: Fet is that part of us which dreams. Are dreams important to me?

Data:Setup.librarian.cho.json.label: What Remains of Me? Instinct?
Data:Setup.librarian.cho.json.startdescription: The human soul has nine parts. Exuberance, enthusiasm, instinct all rise from that part of the soul we call chor. Is my chor strong? [Recover this. The other two possibilities will be lost to the sea... for now.]
Data:Setup.librarian.cho.json.desc: This is the coast where Brancrug Isle lies. It wasn't easy to come here... but I don't give up easily. Even so, I know there's no way I can cross to the isle in these seas. I'll need to find shelter for the night.
Data:Setup.librarian.cho.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Setup.librarian.consider.ability.hi.label: I've begun to remember -
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.ability.hi.startdescription: This element of my soul is strong. What else? [Choose another Memory, and recover another Element of the Soul.]

Data:Setup.librarian.consider.journalwit.label: Yes?
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.journalwit.startdescription: This book helped me remember something. What else can I recall?

Data:Setup.librarian.consider.json.label: The cold comes first
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.json.desc: Thunder growling. Waves pounding... and finally me, sprawled on the sodden sand of the beach. There's something in my hand.
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.json.comments: in built version, music fx at start in gamegateway don't trigger reliably

Data:Setup.librarian.consider.mem.storm..label: Scattered Memories
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.mem.storm..startdescription: I can't get my thoughts straight. But there's something in my hand... [Your single remaining possession is in a Belongings slot at the top.]

Data:Setup.librarian.consider.shipwrecke.label: Freezing Fingers
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.shipwrecke.startdescription: The book's in bad shape, and I'm not much better. We're both in need of a warm dry safe place, and soon.

Data:Setup.librarian.consider.shipwrecke.label: I Remember...?
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.shipwrecke.startdescription: Perhaps this book can help me put the pieces together.

Data:Setup.librarian.consider.xhea.halfd.label: Alive, Approximately
Data:Setup.librarian.consider.xhea.halfd.startdescription: I'm soaked, I'm freezing, but as far as I can tell, I'm still alive. [You still have some Health. Don't lose it. You need it, if you want to be alive. What else do you have? Your single remaining possession is in a Belongings slot at the top.]

Data:Setup.librarian.day.json.label: After the Storm: Approaching Dawn
Data:Setup.librarian.day.json.startdescription: The stars have struggled through the storm-rags of cloud, but they retreat now as the dawn approaches...
Data:Setup.librarian.day.json.comments: This is called when the player marks that they've reached the beginning of the game proper - by visiting one of the village contacts.

Data:Setup.librarian.ereb.json.label: What Remains of Me? Passion?
Data:Setup.librarian.ereb.json.startdescription: Ereb is the shadow in the soul's cellar: pride, fear, hatred, compassion. [Choose a strong ereb, and a past where your passions were paramount. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Setup.librarian.ereb.json.desc:
I wanted something I didn't have. I don't have very much at all now, do I? I suppose that should make it easier.

First things first. I remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there.

[Mysteries have been added to your Journal. You can begin to investigate them when you and your journal are both dry.]
Data:Setup.librarian.ereb.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Setup.librarian.fet.json.label: What Remains of Me? Dreams?
Data:Setup.librarian.fet.json.startdescription: The human soul has nine parts. Fet is that part of the soul that dreams. Is my fet strong? [Recover this. The other two possibilities will be lost to the sea... for now.]
Data:Setup.librarian.fet.json.desc: This is the coast where Brancrug Isle lies. I've seen it in my dreams, night after night. I know there's no way I can cross to the isle in these seas. I'll need to find shelter for the night.
Data:Setup.librarian.fet.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Setup.librarian.mettle.json.label: What Remains of Me? My strength of character?
Data:Setup.librarian.mettle.json.startdescription: Mettle is the soul's tempering - will; self-discipline; that part of us which makes the right choice. [Choose a strong mettle, and a past where you made mistakes. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Setup.librarian.mettle.json.desc:
Perhaps here I can atone for all I've done. But what was that, exactly?

First things first. I remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there.

[Mysteries have been added to your Journal. You can begin to investigate them when you and your journal are both dry.]
Data:Setup.librarian.mettle.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Setup.librarian.phost.json.label: What Remains of Me? Light?
Data:Setup.librarian.phost.json.startdescription: Phost is the light within: sight, perception, inspiration. [Choose a strong phost, and a past with a pursuer who can see the light within you. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Setup.librarian.phost.json.desc:
Perhaps here I'll find safety from what follows me. But what was that, exactly?

First things first. I remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there.

[Mysteries have been added to your Journal. You can begin to investigate them when you and your journal are both dry.]
Data:Setup.librarian.phost.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Setup.librarian.season.json.label: The Crossroads of Seasons
Data:Setup.librarian.season.json.comments: This is called when the player marks that they've reached the beginning of the game proper - by visiting one of the village contacts.

Data:Setup.librarian.shapt.json.label: What Remains of Me? Words?
Data:Setup.librarian.shapt.json.startdescription: The human soul has nine parts. Eloquence and understanding rise from that part of the soul we call shapt. Is my shapt strong? [Recover this. The other two possibilities will be lost to the sea... for now.]
Data:Setup.librarian.shapt.json.desc: This is the coast where Brancrug Isle lies. My sources briefed me thoroughly about the place, and I know there's no way I can cross to the isle in these seas. I'll need to find shelter for the night.
Data:Setup.librarian.shapt.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Setup.librarian.shipwrecked.json.label: I Remember...
Data:Setup.librarian.shipwrecked.json.startdescription: There was a storm. It smashed the ship like an egg. But I seized this book as the sea seized me... then the sea brought me here to Brancrug.
Data:Setup.librarian.shipwrecked.json.desc: There was a storm. It smashed the ship like an egg. But I seized this book as the sea seized me... then the sea brought me here to Brancrug. And Brancrug is where I wanted to be. But it's hard to remember why. What else did I lose in the storm?
Data:Setup.librarian.shipwrecked.json.comments: in built version, music fx at start in gamegateway don't trigger reliably

Data:Setup.librarian.talk.cho.json.label: Something in the Wind?
Data:Setup.librarian.talk.cho.json.startdescription: My instinct tells me it might be this way - and without a map, instinct is as good a compass as any.
Data:Setup.librarian.talk.cho.json.desc: The cliffs grow dark against the ragged stars - and then at last, I see the light of a hurricane lamp bobbing in the dark. As it approaches, a face glimmers above the lamp.

Data:Setup.librarian.talk.fet.json.label: Déjà Vu?
Data:Setup.librarian.talk.fet.json.startdescription: Did I dream of this beach and this wind?  If I did, I might remember the path I took in that dream -  a path which brought me light.
Data:Setup.librarian.talk.fet.json.desc: At last, the light of a hurricane lamp bobbing in the dark. As it approaches, a face looms out of the night.

Data:Setup.librarian.talk.json.label: Shelter?
Data:Setup.librarian.talk.json.startdescription: Brancrug Village must be nearby. But it's hard going, dragging my soaked body across the soaked sand in the teeth of this wind. Which way?

Data:Setup.librarian.talk.shapt.json.label: A Cry for Help?
Data:Setup.librarian.talk.shapt.json.startdescription: Perhaps there's someone out there even in this weather. I can fill my lungs and bellow for help. (That would also mean I don't need to crawl any further.)
Data:Setup.librarian.talk.shapt.json.desc: At last, I see the light of a hurricane lamp bobbing in the dark. As it approaches, a face glimmers above the lamp.

Data:Setup.librarian.wist.json.label: What Remains of Me? Knowledge?
Data:Setup.librarian.wist.json.startdescription: Wist is the soul's memory, the true name scratched on its cornerstone, what remains after the rest has passed. [Choose a strong wist, and a past where you sought voices that had fallen silent. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Setup.librarian.wist.json.desc: There are still things I don't remember. But I do remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there. [Mysteries have been added to your Journal. You can begin to investigate them when you and your journal are both dry.]
Data:Setup.librarian.wist.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Setup.met.json.label: Memory: Mettle?
Data:Setup.met.json.desc: Mettle is the capacity for meaningful choice. Did I prove my mettle?

Data:Setup.pho.json.label: Memory: Phost?
Data:Setup.pho.json.desc: Phost is sight, perception, inspiration, all the Glory's gifts. Is my soul a bright soul?

Data:Setup.sha.json.label: Memory: Shapt?
Data:Setup.sha.json.desc: Shapt is eloquence and also understanding: the door opens both ways. Is my soul open to knowledge?

Data:Setup.tri.json.label: Memory: Trist?
Data:Setup.tri.json.desc: Trist, they say, is the change and the longing. Do I miss something I never had?

Data:Setup.wis.json.label: Memory: Wist?
Data:Setup.wis.json.desc: Wist is the name, the memory - that part which remains. Is it important to me that things endure?

Data:Sevenpoundnote.json.label: Seven Pound Note
Data:Sevenpoundnote.json.desc: Swirls and curlicues in solemn hues. Until recently, one could exchange bank notes for gold in the banks of the capital. A seven-pound note can still be exchanged for rarer metals in rarer places.

Data:Shears.sisterhood.json.Label: Shears of the Sisterhood
Data:Shears.sisterhood.json.Desc: Black iron shears marked with the Sisterhood's triple knot.

xexts.scrutiny: Much older than much of the House, but still remarkably sharp.

Data:Shield.drake.red.json.Label: Red Drake Shield
Data:Shield.drake.red.json.Desc: Painted leather, riveted to heavy iron.

xexts.scrutiny: This is clearly a reproduction or facsimile, perhaps from the mid nineteenth century - but it is heavy and durable. The leather is strongly textured, with small scales arranged in a diamond pattern.

Data:Shield.lion.golden.json.Label: Golden Lion Shield
Data:Shield.lion.golden.json.Desc: Painted leather, riveted to heavy iron.

xexts.scrutiny: This is clearly a reproduction or facsimile, perhaps from the mid nineteenth century - but it is heavy and durable. The leather is stiff and coarse - it might be cowhide, or perhaps even lionhide.

Data:Shield.stag.green.json.Label: Green Stag Shield
Data:Shield.stag.green.json.Desc: Painted leather, riveted to heavy iron.

xexts.scrutiny: This is clearly a reproduction or facsimile, perhaps from the mid nineteenth century - but it is heavy and durable. The leather is fine-grained and subtle, and may in fact be deerhide.

Data:Shilling.json.label: Shilling
Data:Shilling.json.desc: Twelve pence or, if you prefer, one-twentieth of a pound.

Data:Ship.model.kerisham.json.Label: HMS Kerisham
Data:Ship.model.kerisham.json.Desc: A fourth-rate ship of the line captained by Sebastian Dewulf in the Battle of Quiberon Bay. Lost with all hands.

Data:Sign.salt.json.Label: Salt-Sign
Data:Sign.salt.json.Desc: Too bad it won't last. But then again, what does?

xexts.scrutiny: It didn't last. [Certain Prentice-level Rose and Moon recipes which can be used to create this.]

Data:Sixpence.json.label: Sixpence
Data:Sixpence.json.desc: The silver coin of least value - but silver, nonetheless.
